responsibility: Implements the post-register-allocation redundant extension elimination pass that removes explicit zero/sign-extension instructions when the defining hard-register instructions can be widened or otherwise rewritten to produce the extended value directly. Using DF MIR and DU/UD chains, it identifies removable extension candidates, traces all reaching definitions including conditional moves, validates that merged definitions remain recognizable RTL patterns, inserts repair copies when source and destination registers differ, and deletes the now-redundant extension insns.
